title: Composite Qualification Audit — five obligations, interaction contracts, environment difference maps

source.source_reference: Shawn's explicit teaching, main chat, 2026-10-10. Filed same-evening per his standing law: his word IS the verification (Verification Law); filed immediately, not queued.

intelligence.essence: Component success plus component success does not equal system success. A composite — anything built from qualified parts — must pass its own audit: five obligations covering the parts, their interactions, the composition, the environment, and the whole's behavior. Interaction contracts specify what the parts assume about each other; environment difference maps record where the deployment context differs from the test context. The audit's standing finding: integration is a claim that needs its own proof, and 'it worked in staging' is evidence about staging, not production.

human_view.meaning: Nine parts that each pass their own test can still fail together. The connections between parts need their own proof — and 'it worked in the lab' doesn't prove 'it works in the real world.'
human_view.why_it_matters: This is the law the whole NayaNET vision rests on: a collective intelligence is a composite, and composites are guilty until proven innocent.

simple_view.meaning: Nine parts that each pass their own test can still fail together. The connections between parts need their own proof — and 'it worked in the lab' doesn't prove 'it works in the real world.'

naya_view.directive: Audit every composite against the five obligations. Write interaction contracts for part-to-part assumptions. Map environment differences between test and deployment contexts. Never cite component qualifications as system qualification.

ai_view.specification: qualify(composite) requires the five obligations; interaction_contract(part_i, part_j) enumerates mutual assumptions; env_diff(test, deploy) must be mapped and each difference dispositioned.
ai_view.directive: Follow as written. This is law, not guidance.

machine_view.spec_only: Spec-only by design; live KNOW/LAW/ACT wiring parked for the Human Director's word. No production claim.
machine_view.test_evidence: Composite-audit spec L3: audit spec'd (five obligations, interaction contracts, environment difference maps).

intelligence.learning_lesson: Applied 2026-10-10: each stacked spec branch was audited against its parent before stacking — the practice this law makes permanent.
decisions: Shawn's word ratifies the teaching. His word IS the verification; no second verification of the lesson itself is permitted (Verification Law).

connections.target: SN-0761 Combining evidence — the composition it checks.
SN-0766 Multi-obligation invariants — the joint-behavior rules it enforces.

intelligence.uncertainty: The five obligations' exact contents are implementer-defined; the requirement that composites carry their own proof is fixed.
intelligence.applicability: Every seat that assembles, deploys, or qualifies a composite system.
intelligence.falsifier: Falsified if a composite is qualified on component results alone, or an unmapped environment difference causes a deployment failure.
intelligence.measurement_contract: Count composites qualified with vs without interaction contracts; track env-diff coverage.
intelligence.successor_effect: A cold successor handed a 'fully tested' composite asks for the interaction contracts and the environment map before believing it.
